- [RARC.5.7.6] **Cache-op dispatcher.** Routes the `cache` and
  `cache_delete` write actions to the integrator's
  optional write-through persistence callbacks. The
  cache itself is engine state ([LSTO.4.7.1]), so a
  `cached(...)` read — the let-RHS expression form per
  [LGRA.9.8.2] — is served from the in-engine map with
  no callback, and completes in-rule at RHS entry.
